array.string: mkdir -p "$HOME/Documents/syslogwatch" && PYTHONPATH="__PROJECT__/addon/app" python3 -m syslogwatch.cli analyze --since 24h --format html -o "$HOME/Documents/syslogwatch/informe.html" && PYTHONPATH="__PROJECT__/addon/app" python3 -m syslogwatch.cli analyze --since 24h --format markdown -o "$HOME/Documents/syslogwatch/informe.md"
